title: Cracked Orb of Renewal
description: A large cracked glass orb with golden repairs sits atop a tall flowering mullein plant in a misty forest. The orb contains a miniature scene of a winding path lined with yellow flowers, while a smaller cracked orb with a flowering spire rests on top, surrounded by floating golden flakes and radiant pastel light beams.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a giant cracked glass orb held together by glowing golden kintsugi repairs, containing an entire miniature misty forest path lined with tall yellow mullein flowers. The orb rests on a giant mullein plant in the foreground. A smaller cracked orb with a flowering spire sits on top. Golden flakes float in the air as pastel pink, yellow and green light beams break through a foggy forest background.
